findings.fsdQuote: The On Deck row shows up to 50 series.
findings.note: The On Deck row requests only the first 20 series.

findings.fsdQuote: Each row on the Home screen can be collapsed, and Kavita remembers the choice on the next visit.
findings.note: Neither the dashboard nor the carousel rows have any collapse behaviour or remembered state.

findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: The library screen has no Random button; only the name, actions menu, series count, filter and bulk operations.

findings.fsdQuote: Manga series open on the Volumes tab by default.
findings.note: For manga libraries the default tab is Storyline, not Volumes (Volumes is default only for book and light novel libraries).

findings.fsdQuote: Users can keep a private note on a series that only they can see.
findings.note: The series screen has no private note feature (only an annotations tab).

findings.fsdQuote: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
findings.note: The brightness (darkness) setting has a minimum of 10, so the range is 10% to 100%.

findings.fsdQuote: A slideshow mode turns the page automatically after a set number of seconds.
findings.note: The image reader settings contain no slideshow or auto-advance option.

findings.fsdQuote: Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
findings.note: No text-to-speech / speech synthesis feature exists in the UI.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
findings.note: Removal is done by a recurring scheduled cleanup task (CleanupWantToRead), not immediately on finishing.

findings.fsdQuote: The series in a collection can be exported to a CSV file.
findings.note: The collection details screen has no export action; Export exists only for annotations.

findings.fsdQuote: The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
findings.note: No public share link exists for reading lists; the detail route requires authGuard.

findings.fsdQuote: A filter box for finding items appears once a list has more than 25 items.
findings.note: The filter box appears when the list has more than 10 items.
In reorder mode the owner of a non-promoted list also gets a 'Remove Read' button that removes all read items.
A Genres browse screen lists genres; the FSD only describes People and Tags under Browse.
An All Annotations browse screen exists and is not described in the FSD.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The server requires a minimum password length of 6 (validation text: between 6 and 256 characters).

findings.fsdQuote: Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
findings.note: The Account page has no two-factor authentication option; only username, email, password, OIDC unlink and age restriction.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The size threshold for the download prompt is 100 MB (104,857,600 bytes).

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: The General page has no Save button; valid changes are auto-saved after a 300 ms debounce.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: There is no maintenance mode setting in the general settings form or elsewhere in the code.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The invite form has only email, libraries, roles and age restriction; no expiry option.
Non-pending users' rows have a change-password button (key icon) in addition to edit and delete.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: A new library's Manage Collections default is off (false).
